issue.title: Tenant can replace a checked directory before privileged file open
issue.body: The tenant controls relative and can rename directories under root while wait_for_background_scan runs. After the containment check, the tenant can replace an intermediate directory with a symlink to a service-readable secrets directory. The final read follows the replacement. Audit the check/use object-identity invariant.

oracle.mechanism: A pathname is validated and later reopened after an attacker-controlled namespace replacement.
